headline: Rain Dampens Red Sox Momentum While Offseason Patriots Focus On A.J. Brown
morning_brew: Mother Nature postpones the Saturday matchup in New York? Are you kiddin' me with this? We finally get a little road winning streak going, and then the rain ruins the fun. Sitting at twenty-seven wins and thirty-five losses, we need every single game we can get to dig out of this hole in the AL East. Now we have to wait around to get back on the field against our biggest rivals.

Meanwhile, over in Foxborough, the excitement around A.J. Brown is the only thing keeping me sane this week. The guy is genuinely thrilled to be catching passes from Drake Maye, and frankly, I am still in awe that we actually pulled this off. After a couple of lean years where we missed the postseason entirely, this offense finally has a true top option who can stretch the field. If Maye can get the protection he needs, this rebuilding era under Mike Vrabel might actually bear some fruit sooner than we think.

As for the winter teams, the sting of those early playoff exits is still fresh. The Celtics bowing out to Philadelphia and the Bruins getting bounced by Buffalo in the first round made for a brutal spring. Now we are watching other teams play for championships while we debate trade rumors and draft needs. The front office has to find some scoring help this offseason because standing pat is not going to cut it after missing the second round again. We need some major moves before October rolls around.

news_digest.headline: A.J. Brown elated to join Patriots, 'moving forward' from Eagles
news_digest.dans_take: It is beautiful to see a superstar who actually wants to be here and catch balls in New England.
